findings.message: The ticket requires Rig to use FakeFileSystem and FakeJournal while keeping its hub tests working unchanged, but these tests directly read and inspect real paths and independently reopen a real Journal for persistence and recovery.
findings.paved_road: Allow the hub tests to be rewritten for the fake-backed Rig, or retain a separate real-I/O rig for those tests and clarify the resulting ownership and scope.
